name: Zurishaddai
overview: Zurishaddai is identified in Scripture as the father of Shelumiel, a prominent leader of the tribe of Simeon during Israel's wilderness journey. The passages in Numbers highlight Shelumiel’s role as prince and captain of Simeon, emphasizing his leadership in organizing the tribe’s camp and offerings. Through Shelumiel, Zurishaddai’s name is associated with the faithful stewardship and service of Simeon’s people under God's direction.
